newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-NORWICH AND CRYSTAL PALACE FINED FOR BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NORWICH AND CRYSTAL PALACE FINED FOR BRAWL.

text.p: English first division clubs Norwich and Crystal Palace were each fined 40,000 pounds ($64,000) on Friday for a mass on-field brawl involving their players in a league match in December.

The two clubs must each pay 10,000 pounds ($16,000) of their fines now with the remaining 30,000 pounds ($48,000) suspended until June of next year when it will be waived if there are no further similar offences.
Both clubs issued unqualified apologies to the Football Association (F.A.) and admitted a charge of "failing to control their players".
Norwich said all of their players on the field at the time had already been fined.
